detail: Six pressure loggers at $4,200 each are budgeted as equipment. NSF's equipment threshold is $10,000 a unit (PAPPG 24-1 Supplement 1), so they are supplies, and belong in the F&A base.
The budget supports a postdoctoral researcher and a graduate student. The PAPPG requires a one-page Mentoring Plan for any proposal that does, and the submission checklist has none.
Draft claims all 8 planned field campaigns under the prior award; the outcomes record and final report show 5 completed.
The PI's committed effort across current and pending support, including this project at 8%, totals 115%.
